test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 8 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘ACNE’ is written as ‘XZVM’ and ‘BODY’ is written as ‘LYBW’. How will ‘EVIL’ be written in that language?
solution: The logic followed here is: Table of english alphabet positional value is as follows: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8455c0124707b57e9f800e56eb0150ffa573557ee5dad7bdd2e126a53d24539f.png] ‘ACNE’ is written as ‘XZVM’ A is sitting opposite to Z according to table as given above. same way all letters are sitting opposite according to positional value table
